localChanges: In a game, a Civilopedia page now says only what applies to you: lines for another difficulty level are left out, a change that's already happened is gone, and of the changes still to come only the next is shown, so a Barracks' upkeep reads as what you pay now and what you'll pay after your next discovery (closes #1310).
"Show every case" on the page shows every line again, for every level and every discovery.
